domain:skills#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQVgxSYnzqhm5KCyhq

Draft note for a later seat (claim released, nothing pushed). The card thread had a draft of the reader before the stand-down; its design, so the next dev need not re-derive it:

- Reader chosen: a new `check-half-states.mjs` row (`H77`), not `scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs`. The rollup is the QA lane's view over the strict `QA run` title grammar, run by the QA seat at its round end; an `eval-run` title is another grammar the eval seat never feeds it. The half-state sweep already lists every open issue (the unscoped listing H13/H18 read), so the row costs no extra request.
- Bound: the scenario-eval skill's close-out bullet (close `completed` once every finding has a destination, never kept open for a fix) plus the eval lane's weekly scenario round (`references/lanes/eval.md`): a record open more than 7 days after `created_at` has outlived its round. `created_at`, never `updated_at`: a comment bumps the latter and closes nothing. An unreadable stamp fires UNJUDGED.
- Shape: exported `EVAL_RUN_RECORD_LABEL` and `EVAL_RUN_RECORD_OPEN_DAYS`, `h77EvalRunRecordOpen(issue, nowMs)`, wired beside H18 in the unscoped loop, band `state` (H18's), a 9-case battery including a pin that H13_EXEMPT_LABELS and H74_EXEMPT_LABELS carry the same label (green only once PR #34110 is on main). No skill-text line was needed.
- Not done: the ablation and the gate run.
